items.record: PK=<function>#<idempotency key> | status IN_PROGRESS|COMPLETED, ownerToken (random per attempt), leaseUntil (ms), fingerprint (optional), result (JSON, absent when resultOmitted), resultOmitted, completedAt (ms), expiresAtEpoch

accessPatterns: claim: PutItem IF attribute_not_exists(PK) OR (status = IN_PROGRESS AND leaseUntil < now) OR expiresAtEpoch < nowSec - a crashed attempt's claim expires, a past-retention record counts as absent
complete: UpdateItem IF ownerToken = token SET status = COMPLETED, result, completedAt
failure: DeleteItem IF ownerToken = token (the retry may run again)
_design.why: SQS is at-least-once and Lambda retries batches: the same message can run twice concurrently on two containers; a conditional write is the cheapest cross-container lock with automatic expiry
